Transformer Manufacturing

Core → winding → insulation → active part → drying → tank & final assembly

Manufacturing Stage

Core Processing

Magnetic-core cutting, stacking and assembly.

Manufacturing Stage

Coil Winding

HV and LV coil winding for the selected conductor and insulation system.

Manufacturing Stage

Insulation & Active Part

Insulation assembly, lead work and active-part integration.

Manufacturing Stage

Vacuum Drying

Insulation drying before oil filling and final assembly.

Manufacturing Stage

Tank & Final Assembly

Tank fabrication, accessories and final transformer integration.

Inspection & Testing

Routine and project-specified testing before release.
